prompt.description: A full scene caption: medium and style, subjects with their colours, materials and positions, background, lighting and camera. Short prompts give generic images. Text to render goes in quotes; boxes for layout can follow as a JSON list of elements with bbox [top, left, bottom, right] on a 0 to 1000 grid.

width.description: Image width in pixels, a multiple of 16; width x height at most 4 megapixels; 1024 when omitted.

height.description: Image height in pixels, a multiple of 16; width x height at most 4 megapixels; 1024 when omitted.

steps.description: Denoising steps; the model is distilled for 16.
